data.body:
Fixes bug B-sx-tasks-pipe-split-titles: SX-seed has title '`ddflow seed plan' and globs ['SX-bundle','KB-layer']; SX-bundle has globs ['verify`: manifest', 'digests', ...]. The import of a title/globs containing '|' or ',' split the text at the delimiter, so titles are cut and task ids/prose became globs (globs that conflict-check wrongly). Seen while checking P-seed-extract for the operator move-forward. Found on SX-seed.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-sx-tasks-pipe-split-titles --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-sx-tasks-pipe-split-titles --regression-test <test>` first).

Not attached, they match nothing in the tree: SX-bundle, KB-layer.
data.title: Fix bug B-sx-tasks-pipe-split-titles: SX-seed, SX-bundle, SX-egress-door tasks have truncated titles and garbage globs

data.note: Fix markdown task-table ingestion so titles with literal pipes and comma-separated needs/globs import whole; correction shipped as importer change + regression test.

evidence.note: Probed ddflow.services.importer.scan_todos on docs/plan.md holding a | Id | Title | Needs | Globs | markdown task table whose title cell had an escaped pipe (`ddflow seed plan\|apply`). The unfixed scanner read 0 tasks (it only reads checkboxes; the table was silently dropped), and a naive line.split('|') is what cut SX-seed's title at `plan` and read `SX-bundle,KB-layer` (its needs) as globs. Fix splits cells on unescaped pipes and reads needs->needs, globs->globs. Verdict CONFIRMED (the ingest path dropped/split the task table).

reuses the importer's own _parse_globs/_parse_needs and the pipe-escaping convention views/markdown._cell already writes (r-reuse-core); no new tunable is hard-coded; the scan logic is extracted into helpers so scan_todos keeps its lint complexity budget.

ddflow/services/importer.py now scans a | Id | Title | Needs | Globs | markdown task table via _table_cells/_table_columns/_table_delim/_table_task/_table_row/_scan_task_tables: a title's escaped pipe is read back whole and needs/globs land in their own columns. Regression test tests/test_import_table_titles.py guards it. Committed as c2baa217d.
